import numpy as np

r1 = np.load('/work/fwd/r1/run.npz', allow_pickle=True)
r7 = np.load('/work/fwd/r7/run.npz', allow_pickle=True)

print("=== L0_MLP write change when L0H1 ablated ===")
for inp in range(3):
    diff = np.abs(r1['L0_MLP'][inp] - r7['L0_MLP'][inp])
    print(f"Input {inp}: mean_diff={diff.mean():.5f}, max_diff={diff.max():.5f}")

print()
print("=== L1_MLP write change when L0H1 ablated ===")
for inp in range(3):
    diff = np.abs(r1['L1_MLP'][inp] - r7['L1_MLP'][inp])
    print(f"Input {inp}: mean_diff={diff.mean():.5f}, max_diff={diff.max():.5f}")

print()
# Check L0H1 write in r7 (should be ~0 if ablated)
print(f"L0H1 write r7 input 0 max: {np.abs(r7['L0H1_ATTN'][0]).max():.5f}")
print(f"L0H1 write r1 input 0 max: {np.abs(r1['L0H1_ATTN'][0]).max():.5f}")

print()
# Summary of all tests for each component
print("=== SUMMARY: MLP upstream dependencies ===")
print("L0_MLP changes when ablated:")
r3 = np.load('/work/fwd/r3/run.npz', allow_pickle=True)
for name, abl_run in [('L0H0', r3), ('L0H1', r7)]:
    diffs = [np.abs(r1['L0_MLP'][i] - abl_run['L0_MLP'][i]).mean() for i in range(3)]
    print(f"  Ablate {name}: mean per input = {[f'{d:.2f}' for d in diffs]}")
    
print("L1_MLP changes when ablated:")
r5 = np.load('/work/fwd/r5/run.npz', allow_pickle=True)
for name, abl_run in [('L0H0', r3), ('L0H1', r7), ('L0_MLP', r5)]:
    diffs = [np.abs(r1['L1_MLP'][i] - abl_run['L1_MLP'][i]).mean() for i in range(3)]
    print(f"  Ablate {name}: mean per input = {[f'{d:.2f}' for d in diffs]}")
